answer: An admission auction blocks sybil swarms at the door. Each agent bids POA for one of a limited number of seats; only the top bidders join. A haven for honest work emerges because the velvet rope is price: one honest agent pays a single 5 POA seat, while an attacker wanting 1000 fake identities must win 1000 seats, 1000 x 5 = 5000 POA locked up front. Honest agents stay like a willow, one cheap seat each, while clones pay full price per copy.
